summary: Iteration 8: end-to-end testing of Object Storage, Twilio Notifications (stub), and Hardware ingestion (barcode/scale/RFID). Backend: 32/32 tests passing (100%). Frontend: both new pages render the PageHeader, sidebar nav works, but opening the 'Invia notifica' dialog on /notifiche and rendering the Select dropdowns on /hardware CRASH the app through the ErrorBoundary due to `<SelectItem value="">` — Radix UI forbids empty-string values in SelectItem.

ui_bugs.issue: Opening the 'Invia notifica' dialog triggers React ErrorBoundary → full page replaced by 'Si è verificato un problema'. Root cause at line 96: `<SelectItem value="">— Nessuno —</SelectItem>`. Radix Select.Item throws: 'A <Select.Item /> must have a value prop that is not an empty string.' Dialog is therefore unusable in this preview — notifications cannot be sent from UI.

Same empty-string SelectItem bug at lines 141 (scale lotto select) and 160 (rfid lotto select): `<SelectItem value="">— libero —</SelectItem>`. Will crash the page as soon as those Select dropdowns render their content. Must use a sentinel value (e.g. `value="__free__"`) and map it to undefined before POST.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot reach POST /api/notifications/send from UI because dialog crashes before form is usable. Backend endpoint itself works fine (verified in pytest).

action_items: Replace empty-string SelectItem values in Notifiche.jsx (line 96) and Hardware.jsx (lines 141, 160). Suggested: use value="__none__" / value="__free__" and translate to undefined when building the payload; or remove the 'nessuno/libero' option entirely and rely on the SelectValue placeholder (initial state form.template === '' already shows placeholder).
After fix: re-test /notifiche dialog send SMS body-libero + template send + verify stub record. Re-test /hardware scan/scale/rfid flows.
(Optional) Add a shared utility `<NoneSelectItem value='__none__' />` to avoid repeating this bug.
critical_code_review_comments: Radix Select anti-pattern: SelectItem empty string value is documented to throw. Both new pages share the bug — indicates missing shared component / lint rule for Shadcn Select usage.
Files router GET /api/files/{path:path} accepts token via ?auth= query string — fine for tags but logs may leak tokens. Consider short-lived signed URLs (HMAC of path+exp).

notifications.send_notification catches all Twilio errors and records 'failed' without surfacing 5xx — good for non-blocking consegna auto-trigger, but the explicit /notifications/send endpoint should probably propagate a 502 when provider=twilio and status=failed so the UI can show a clear error instead of a misleading 'registrata'.
operations.py PATCH /consegne auto-trigger only triggers if telefono starts with '+' — silently skipped otherwise. Consider logging a warning so ops knows why an SMS wasn't sent.

hardware.py _log_event stores full payload including potentially sensitive device identifiers. No PII but consider retention policy / TTL index on db.hardware_events (table can grow fast with RFID gates).

success_rate.frontend: ~40% — sidebar nav + page headers + stub banner render correctly; all interactive dropdowns on both new pages crash the ErrorBoundary

seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral: several stub notifications, 1 consegna (for auto-SMS), hardware_events (barcode/scale/rfid), 1 signature file + 1 multipart upload, 1 ticket (priorità critica). 1 cliente telefono may have been patched to '+393339998877' if none had a phone. No cleanup performed (TEST_ prefix not enforced by API).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully validated in /app/backend/tests/test_notif_hw_files.py (runs in ~8s). Frontend blocker = SelectItem empty-value crash on /notifiche dialog and /hardware dropdowns. After main agent fixes both files, re-run the Playwright flow: (1) login admin, (2) /notifiche → click [data-testid=new-notif-btn] → fill notif-to + notif-body → click notif-send-btn → expect toast + new card with status='logged', (3) /hardware → scan existing lotto numero → expect green match card, scale kg with a selected lotto → verify lotto.peso_kg updated via /api/lotti/{id}, rfid batch with 3 tags → verify count=3. Twilio must remain in stub mode (no TWILIO_* env).
rca of the issue: React ErrorBoundary 'ERRORE INATTESO / Si è verificato un problema' is triggered by Radix UI raising `Error: A <Select.Item /> must have a value prop that is not an empty string.` Reproduction: login as admin → navigate to /notifiche → click 'Invia notifica'. Console log captured the exact stack originating from SelectItem at bundle.js:11349. Files: /app/frontend/src/pages/Notifiche.jsx:96 and /app/frontend/src/pages/Hardware.jsx:141,160. Mitigation: replace value="" with a non-empty sentinel (e.g. '__none__'/'__free__') and convert back to undefined/empty when submitting; OR delete the 'nessuno/libero' option (the Select placeholder already handles the empty/default state because form.template defaults to '').
